node.statement: Set R=U_r union {j_{r+1}}, epsilon_R:=W.L*epsilon, and t_2:=W.K2*epsilon. Node 1.1 and lem-maincb-structural-domain-ledger give epsilon <= W.e_s2/W.K2, 0 <= t_2 <= W.r_reset, and A_R extended epsilon_R-C*-algebra. The induction hypothesis supplies exactly the reset isomorphism and bounds on U_r required by lem-maincb-stage2-call-envelope, while U_r is nonempty and j_{r+1} is a new index in the same class. Hence that lemma supplies the explicit Stage-2 EXT raw-call datum; lem-maincb-stage2-raw-extension supplies its literal extended D_2*t_2-isomorphism u_2:M_{r+1}->A_R with the stated near-unit estimate, and lem-maincb-reset-constant-ledger certifies it uniformly as an eligible D_*t_2 raw call.
